youtube_title: He said two words to me at the mailbox. I have thought about them for nine hours 🧶
description:
Nia's new neighbor Derek said nice sweater at the mailbox. Now her best friend Omar, a piece of toast and Nia are going to figure out what he meant, one word at a time.

#cartoon #animation #funny #sweater #shorts

lines.text: Omar. Derek from apartment four said two words to me at the mailbox.
It is eleven at night. What two words?
Nice sweater.
I am her toast. She made me at two in the afternoon. She has not eaten me. She has been thinking.
Nice sweater is nice. Goodnight.
No. Listen. Nice sweater. Or was it nice. Sweater.
Those are the same words.
They are not. There was a crumb of silence in the middle. I know crumbs.
If he said nice, loud, then he likes me.
If he said sweater, loud, then he likes the sweater more than me.
Which one was loud?
The mailbox. The mailbox was very loud. It squeaks.
Let the record show the mailbox has ruined everything.
Okay. Show me the sweater.
My grandma Ruth made it. It has a reindeer. The reindeer has a smaller sweater.
The reindeer is wearing a sweater with another reindeer on it.
It goes down nine reindeer. Bring a magnifying glass.
So he could have meant nice like nice. Or nice like wow.
Or nice like he has eyes.
We need to act it out. You be Derek.
I am not being Derek.
Nice sweater.
No, he did a little nod. And he was holding a package. Hold the toast.
I have never been a package. I am so ready.
Nice. Sweater.
Again, but like a man who owns a canoe.
How does Derek own a canoe?
There is a canoe on his balcony, Omar. I am not blind.
Nia. Just knock on his door and ask.
Ask a man what he meant by two words? Are you a monster?
Somebody is knocking. It is not a monster. It is worse. It is Derek.
Hi. Sorry. It is late. I just had to ask you something.
Hi. Yes. Hi. Go ahead.
Wait. Derek. Why are you wearing the same sweater?
That is my question. Where did you get yours?
My grandma Ruth. She lives in apartment one.
Grandma Ruth from apartment one is my grandma too. Not my real one. She just decided.
She decided you were her grandson?
The first week I moved in. She brought soup and a sweater and a new last name.
Grandma Ruth is running a family. In a building. With yarn.
I think she is trying to set us up. She asked if I like canoes and toast.
She asked me the same thing. I said yes to both.
I have been a part of this plan the whole time. I am honored. I am cold.
So. Derek. What did you mean by nice sweater?
Nice. Matching. Sweater.
Three words. He said three words. Omar, I need another nine hours.
I am going home. Grandma Ruth gave me a sweater too.
Is it the one with nine reindeer?
Ten. I am her favorite.
Will anybody eat me? Anybody at all?
Nice toast.
Nice. Toast. Oh no. What did he mean by that?
